title: aidentyack.com drawn as the Aiden Tyack handoff draws it

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-23 05:52Z, with a capture of the live site: "didn't actually sign off on this as if you had built the site from the handoff right?"

detail: The live aidentyack.com was the Aiden Tyack skin over a generic layout: every section boxed inside the page column, a full-photo hero, card steps, a left-ruled quote, and the shop, reviews and questions hidden because the kit's words were still flagged as sample. It now draws the handoff's ui_kits/site home section by section. Sections run edge to edge in the design's 1320px column. The forest hero is the split hero on the band with the redwood silhouette at 40% and a product photo. The shop is 4:5 photos with name, detail and price. The quote is centred in the voice under the hammers mark. Steps are numbered columns over a stitch. The band gallery runs edge to edge. Reviews are stitched quote cards. Questions sit beside their heading. The call is the deep walnut band. The letter and contact sections carry real forms through the Space's lead door. The header has the announce band, the menu, the centred hammers lockup with Leathersmith under the name, and the footer is the pine band with the lockup, link columns and the Built on Frequency label. New: the Letter and Contact role blocks have a form switch (off by default, so every other site renders as before), components/page-editor/blocks/role-forms.tsx. Fixture render: scripts/render/aiden-tyack-site.render.tsx.
